back: Six levels below the tenant root group (not counting the root or subscription level).

front: Minimum retention days for Cool, Cold and Archive tiers?
back: Cool 30, Cold 90, Archive 180. Earlier deletion or tier change incurs an early deletion charge.

Tenant
back: A dedicated instance of Microsoft Entra ID for an organization. Subscriptions trust a tenant for identity.

front: Security principal
back: An identity that can be granted access: user, group, service principal or managed identity.

front: Managed identity
back: An automatically managed identity in Entra ID for an Azure resource. System-assigned (tied to one resource's lifecycle) or user-assigned (standalone, reusable).

front: Service tag
back: A Microsoft-managed name for a group of IP prefixes (e.g., Internet, VirtualNetwork, Storage.WestEurope) used in NSG and firewall rules.

front: Network virtual appliance (NVA)
back: A VM running network functions such as a firewall or router, typically targeted by UDRs.

front: KQL
back: Kusto Query Language — the read-only query language for Log Analytics, e.g., Heartbeat | summarize max(TimeGenerated) by Computer.

front: Diagnostic setting
back: Configuration on a resource that routes its platform logs and metrics to Log Analytics, storage, Event Hubs or a partner solution.

front: Idempotent deployment
back: Deploying the same template repeatedly yields the same end state without duplicating resources.

front: Availability zone
back: A physically separate datacenter (or group) within a region with independent power, cooling and networking.

front: Shared access signature (SAS)
back: A signed URI token granting limited, time-bound permissions to storage resources.

front: RBAC or Policy: 'Only allow VM sizes from the D-series'?
back: Azure Policy (Allowed virtual machine size SKUs). RBAC can't restrict property values.

front: Service endpoint or private endpoint: on-premises must access a storage account privately over ExpressRoute?
back: Private endpoint. Service endpoints don't apply to on-premises traffic.

front: Load Balancer or Application Gateway: TLS termination and cookie-based affinity for a website?
back: Application Gateway (Layer 7).

front: Backup or Site Recovery: run the app in another region within 15 minutes of an outage?
back: Azure Site Recovery.

front: Metrics or logs: chart CPU every minute and alert immediately when it spikes?
back: Metrics (metric alert).

front: Entra role or Azure RBAC role: allow a user to create new users?
back: Entra role — User Administrator.

front: Availability set or availability zone: protect against a datacenter fire?
back: Availability zones.

front: Azure Files or Blob: lift-and-shift app needs a mapped network drive?
back: Azure Files (SMB).

front: VPN or ExpressRoute: traffic must not traverse the public internet?
back: ExpressRoute.

front: NSG or Azure Firewall: allow outbound HTTPS only to *.contoso.com?
back: Azure Firewall application rule (FQDN filtering). NSGs can't filter by FQDN.

front: Management group or administrative unit: delegate password resets for one office?
back: Administrative unit (it scopes Entra roles). Management groups are for Azure subscriptions.

front: ACI or Container Apps: microservice that autoscales on HTTP traffic and to zero when idle?
back: Azure Container Apps.

front: Trap: 'Grant the developer Contributor so they can assign Reader to testers.'
back: Contributor can't assign roles. They'd need Owner, User Access Administrator or RBAC Administrator.

front: Trap: 'The Owner can delete the resource group despite the Delete lock.'
back: False. Locks apply to everyone, including Owners — remove the lock first.

front: Trap: 'Assigning a Deny policy removes existing non-compliant resources.'
back: False. Deny only blocks new create/update requests; existing resources are flagged non-compliant.

front: Trap: 'VNet A and C both peer with B, so A can reach C.'
back: False — peering isn't transitive.

front: Trap: 'GRS lets apps read from the secondary region at any time.'
back: False — that's RA-GRS. GRS secondary data is readable only after failover.

front: Trap: 'Add the existing VM to an availability set from its settings.'
back: Not possible — availability set membership is set at creation. Redeploy the VM into the set.

front: Trap: 'Create a staging slot on the Basic tier.'
back: Deployment slots require Standard or higher.

front: Trap: 'Add 10.0.1.0/24 to the storage firewall IP rules.'
back: IP rules accept public IPs only. For a VNet subnet, add a virtual network rule (with a service endpoint) or use a private endpoint.

front: Trap: 'Create the Recovery Services vault in West US to back up VMs in East US.'
back: The vault must be in the same region as the VMs it backs up.

front: Trap: 'Add the devices to the Microsoft 365 group to apply settings.'
back: Microsoft 365 groups can't contain devices — use a security group.

front: Trap: 'Memory usage inside the VM is available as a platform metric by default.'
back: Guest OS memory metrics require the Azure Monitor Agent (or VM insights). Host metrics don't show guest memory usage.

front: Trap: 'The UDR points to the NVA, so traffic flows through it.'
back: Only if IP forwarding is enabled on the NVA's NIC (and in its OS); otherwise traffic is dropped.
